name: OwnerIndex correctness gate (G14-01-POST-OWNER-01)

findings.title: Eliminate group.First() correctness back-door in BuildOwnerIndex
findings.before: FspmModelBinder.BuildOwnerIndex used group.First() on (Assembly, Namespace, MemberName) keys. With two Type facts sharing a key, one was silently dropped.
findings.after: BuildOwnerIndex now returns IReadOnlyDictionary<TypeFactOwnerKey, OwnerResolution> with explicit 0/1/>1 semantics: Zero / One / Many candidate counts. Many never auto-picks; every candidate identity is surfaced.

findings.title: OwnerKey invariant — Assembly + Namespace + MetadataName
findings.before: Owner key silently over-loaded fact.Logical.MemberName to mean Type Name. MemberName's real meaning is INamedTypeSymbol.MetadataName (backtick arity included).
findings.after: OwnerKey centralised in TypeFactOwnerKey struct. KeyForMember joins member.ContainingTypeName (MetadataName) against type.MetadataName, never against type.Name. Cross-Assembly collisions are now distinct keys; same-name cross-namespace collisions are distinct keys.

findings.title: ContainingTypeName must be empty on TypeFact — executable invariant
findings.before: Comment claimed 'a type fact carries an empty ContainingTypeName by construction'. MintLogicalIdentity did null it, but no code enforced it.
findings.after: TryGetOwnerKey rejects any Type fact with non-empty ContainingTypeName; rejection is reported as a note. The BindTypes path also rejects the type record from the model.

findings.title: MemberName / TypeName explicit accessor — no implicit overloading
findings.before: MemberName silently meant both the type's user-facing name (in property/field/method facts) AND the type's CLR MetadataName (in type facts). Single field, two meanings.
findings.after: TypeFactKeys.IsTypeFact() and TryGetOwnerKey() make the type branch explicit. The name-vs-MetadataName divergence for generic types (Name='List', MetadataName='List`1') is a known, documented, non-equal pattern. BindTypes uses fact.Name for the user-facing field; the owner key uses fact.Logical.MemberName (MetadataName).
